items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then we had picked up Cuffy

ctx.x: Trombone. Then we had picked up Cuffy, you remember the great trombone player Cuffy that used to be with McKinney Cotton Pickers. By the time Cuffy had had his career but it was all right.
This was more or less the band that made "The King" with Illinois Jacquet?
